line_items.description: Black Swift S0 sUAS Platforms: 675 aircraft @ escalating unit prices ($18,000 to $20,655)
Mission Days Operational support: 150 days @ $2,850; Operational/Testing Support: 30 sessions @ $6,000; Training sessions (Operator/Observer and Instructor) across 5 periods
Course Development: Operator/Observer and Instructor Training courses (10 courses @ $6,000 each)
Travel for Operational Support (NTE): $50,000 per ordering period × 5 periods
Non-recurring Engineering (NRE) - Labor: Technical Documentation, Modeling, and NHC workflow integration (NTE $66,000 per category × 3 categories × 5 periods)
